title: Recipe Knowledge File
description: Canonical structure for the recipe knowledge file (recipes_full.json). Field names are aligned with data/intent_qa/nutrition_kb.json wherever the concept matches, so both knowledge files share one vocabulary. Use this as the reference contract for any future recipe ingestion.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp the file was produced.

generator.description: Script that produced the file (e.g. parse_recipes.py).

statistics.description: Roll-up counts for quick inspection (mirrors nutrition_kb.json.statistics).

complete_recipes.description: Recipes with both ingredients and instructions.

metadata_only_recipes.description: Recipes with nutrition/clinical info but no ingredients/instructions.

sections.description: The source book's sections and the recipe-number range each covers.

recipe.description: A single recipe. Field names match nutrition_kb.json where the concept is shared (title, description, dietary_tags, symptom_support, instructions, clinical_notes, nutrition, meal_type, cuisine_type, texture_class, servings, prep_time_mins, cook_time_mins, allergen_info, tips, recipe_id, created_at). Book-specific richer fields (recipe_number, emoji, category, stages, nutrition_detail, source citation, image, has_full_recipe) are retained.

meal_type.description: breakfast | soup | main | salad | snack | smoothie | dessert. [nutrition_kb: meal_type]

cuisine_type.description: Cuisine, null when unspecified by source. [nutrition_kb: cuisine_type]

allergens.description: Structured allergen tags for filtering (dairy, gluten, nuts, soy, egg, fish, shellfish, sesame). [book-specific; derived]

allergen_info.description: Human summary, e.g. 'Contains dairy, gluten' or 'None'. [nutrition_kb: allergen_info]

stages.description: Breast-cancer tumour stages the recipe suits (I–IV). NOTE: distinct from nutrition_kb 'treatment_stages' (treatment phase). [book-specific]

stage_display_names.description: Display labels for stages, e.g. 'Stage I'.

clinical_notes.description: Clinical significance / evidence text. [nutrition_kb: clinical_notes; was 'clinical_significance']

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines. Empty when the source omits them. [shared name]

instructions.description: Method steps. Empty when the source omits them. [nutrition_kb: instructions; was 'steps']

tips.description: Serving/preparation tips, null when absent. [nutrition_kb: tips]

has_full_recipe.description: True only when both ingredients and instructions are present. [book-specific]

nutrition.description: Flat per-serving scalars (nutrition_kb shape). sugar_g/sodium_mg are null when the source nutrition table lacks those rows.

nutrition_detail.description: Rich per-nutrient evidence from the source (book-specific). Keys: energy_kcal, protein_g, carbohydrates_g, dietary_fibre_g, total_fat_g, calcium_mg, iron_mg, magnesium_mg, potassium_mg, folate_ug, vitamin_c_mg, stage_suitability.

source.description: The recipe's own citation (distinct from top-level provenance). [book-specific]

image.description: Relative path to the recipe photo, e.g. 'images/recipe-001.png', or null. [book-specific]
